name: Tyr's Hand
summary: In the southeastern hills of the Eastern Plaguelands, Scarlet Crusaders hold Tyr's Hand as their chief stronghold and supply hub. The city was once sacred to the Church of the Holy Light, and its walls remain heavily fortified.

sections.title: A City of Churches
sections.body: Tyr's Hand rises from the old Eastweald, once a green land in Lordaeron, as one of humanity's most ancient sacred sites. Shrines and holy buildings stand across its grounds, giving it the name “city of churches.” The land around it has rotted under blight, yet Tyr's Hand remains remarkably preserved behind thick walls and formidable stonework. The Scarlet Basilica towers above the city.

sections.title: Fortress of the Scarlet Crusade
sections.body:
Lord Valdelmar kept Tyr's Hand standing through military vigilance and faith as the Scourge swept through Lordaeron during the Third War. After the Knights of the Silver Hand split into rival factions, Tyr's Hand joined the Crimson dawn of the Scarlet Crusade. High General Brigitte Abbendis and Valdelmar lead the city from its impenetrable base.

Elite crusaders train in the abbey. Heavily guarded couriers keep contact with Scarlet forces holding Stratholme, while the city ruthlessly rebuffs outsiders at its gates.

faq.q: Why is the city called Tyr's Hand?
faq.answer: The name Tyr's Hand is ancient, and surviving records from Lordaeron say little about who Tyr was. The site is one of the oldest and most revered holy places of the Church of the Holy Light in the old Eastweald.

faq.q: Why hasn't the Scourge overrun Tyr's Hand?
aliases: how is tyrs hand not undead
how does tyrs hand hold out
faq.answer: Tyr's Hand guards a natural mountain chokepoint with formidable stone fortifications, barracks, and an abbey. The Scarlet Crusade keeps an elite, heavily armed garrison there, whose martial zeal and radiant holy magic have repelled relentless Scourge assaults.

faq.q: Are travelers and adventurers welcome in Tyr's Hand?
faq.answer: No. The Scarlet Crusade has fallen into xenophobic paranoia and sees anyone outside its ranks as a possible carrier of the undead plague or a secret Scourge agent. Outsiders are attacked on sight.

faq.q: What role did the city play during the Second War?
faq.answer: During the Second War, Alterac provocateurs secretly stirred a peasant revolt in Tyr's Hand to conceal a nearby orcish mining outpost. After the Alliance and the Silver Hand subdued the unrest, Horde ogre magi heavily bombarded the city and sacked the neighboring bay to cut Quel'Thalas supply lines.

angles.text: For holy warriors, Tyr's Hand shows how an ancient cradle of the Silver Hand can be twisted into a bastion of unyielding Scarlet zealotry when faith loses compassion.
The abbey and Scarlet Basilica are magnificent works of early Church of the Holy Light architecture, though their clergy have traded pastoral healing for blind crusade.
